title: AST-based fail-closed platform policy build gate

categoryRationales.SQL_IMPORT: Reviewed SQLite driver ownership boundary; application clients remain denied direct driver access.
categoryRationales.SQL_CALL: Reviewed database, repository, or sealed infrastructure SQL execution boundary.
categoryRationales.SQL_CONSTRUCTOR: Reviewed SQLite runtime owner that preserves the existing desktop vault ownership model.
categoryRationales.SQL_TAGGED_TEMPLATE: Reviewed SQL template boundary; no unlisted production template is permitted.
categoryRationales.SQL_METHOD_ALIAS: Reviewed SQL method alias boundary; unlisted indirection is denied before build.
categoryRationales.REPOSITORY_IMPORT: Reviewed server-side repository composition or infrastructure adapter boundary; client imports remain denied.
categoryRationales.DATABASE_IMPORT: Reviewed database composition, migration, health, or infrastructure boundary; client imports remain denied.
categoryRationales.CRYPTO_IMPORT: Reviewed cryptographic policy, security primitive, or protected infrastructure adapter boundary.
categoryRationales.CRYPTO_GLOBAL: Reviewed Web Crypto operation inside a protected infrastructure boundary.
categoryRationales.NETWORK_IMPORT: Reviewed governed network egress, local authenticated service, or revocation transport boundary.
categoryRationales.NETWORK_GLOBAL: Reviewed governed network call whose policy adapter remains mandatory.
categoryRationales.DYNAMIC_IMPORT_UNRESOLVED: Non-literal dynamic import or require targets are denied because their capability cannot be proven statically.
categoryRationales.ROLE_PRESENTATION: Renderer-only presentation condition; it grants no authorization and backend policy remains authoritative.
categoryRationales.USE_CASE_COMPOSITION: Reviewed application composition root; runtime authorization and policy enforcement remain mandatory.
